description: Untracked data copied to the backup by scripts/uwtools/backup.py. Additive: nothing is ever deleted in the destination, and a file that would be overwritten is first moved to <destination>/.versions/<timestamp>/. A source is a path (copied to <destination>/<name>) or {path, into} (copied to <destination>/<into>): since 2026-11-01 there are no junctions, so the storage-side trees on D (runs/, refs/processed/physical, refs/source/physical) are sources of their own, landing where they did through the junctions. out/ is not backed up (builds and scratch).
